# pystitch 1.0.1

Unmodified [PyPI wheel](https://pypi.org/project/pystitch/1.0.1/) from the
[Ink/Stitch pystitch project](https://github.com/inkstitch/pystitch).
The wheel contains Python source and carries the MIT license reproduced here.

SHA-256: `06ca3502111e2e782b9d4c4f18a2aa1c5e60588436d7697f2481bfe171f12c1b`

Core embeds this dependency and supplies it to the preview subprocess
through an anonymous file descriptor. Python 3 is required at runtime.
